name: Polymega Collection Vol. 13: Sengoku Blade
summary:
Step into a world where realms collide with this compilation of classic arcade and console titles infused spiritual sorcery. At the heart of the collection is Psikyo’s legendary arcade hit SENGOKU ACE: TENGAI EPISODE I , and its sequel, SENGOKU BLADE -- two dazzling shooters that fuse sword-wielding heroes, mystical spirits, and relentless bullet-hell action. Expanding the action even further, the collection features Psikyo’s arcade shooting gem Dragon Blaze, where warriors ride dragons into battle against otherworldly forces, and Jaleco’s cult sci-fi shooter Saint Dragon, which transforms the player into a cybernetic dragon on a mission of vengeance, playable both in its arcade form and its home port for the PC-Engine.

As a bonus highlight, the set also includes Whomp 'Em, the rare and highly sought-after North American release of Saiyuuki World 2 -- a treasure for collectors and fans alike. Fully playable on Polymega, this collection delivers both nostalgia and discovery, offering an essential journey into the East's most legendary demon-hunting tales.
